messages:
maria_sales: NewBank procurement pinged asking for a single POC assurance bundle: SOC 2 Type II evidence, ISO 27001 snapshot, and a signed pen-test attestation (they said no raw vuln details). They want it by COB Wednesday. Can we assemble?

owen_se: Yes. We have redacted SOC2 PDF, ISO cert image, and ForgeSec exec summary. Procurement only wants an attestation + remediation summary, not the full report. They also asked for a short control diagram of Private/KMS separation.

tara_compliance: I can put together an assurance ZIP and draft the attestation. Questions: 1) Do they need exact engagement dates in the attestation? 2) Any SLA language included? Legal must sign. I can draft in ~12 hours once I have remediation notes.

ben_engineering: For the controls diagram, include: `Customer-managed keys remain in customer VPC; Redwood does not export or persist customer KMS private keys.` Also a one-line about logs: `Audit logs retained per customer settings; export available on request.` I'll attach an SVG.

maria_sales: Procurement also wants a note on pricing for Dedicated vs hosted during POC. Keep it short: "Dedicated trial pricing available; contact sales for quote."

tara_compliance: Proposed attestation text:
```
[Date]
To whom it may concern,
Redwood Inference confirms a third-party penetration test (ForgeSec) covering the inference control plane was performed on [engagement dates]. No unresolved critical findings remain open as of [remediation date]. The full report is restricted; this attestation and the attached remediation summary are provided for vendor assurance.
Sincerely,
Redwood Inference - Compliance
```

evidencebot: Evidence ticket created: EVID-4590 assigned to tara_compliance. Due 1922299999.

tara_compliance: I'll stage: 1) SOC2_TypeII_redacted.pdf, 2) ISO27001_cert.jpg, 3) Attestation_draft.pdf (pending legal), 4) Remediation_summary.pdf, 5) Private_arch_diagram.svg, 6) Pricing_note.txt, 7) Telemetry_statement.txt. Will upload to secure presign and share a short-lived link.

legal_team: Please route the draft attestation to Legal Review channel. We typically approve vendor attestations with engagement date and remediation confirmation. If they later request the full report, we'll require an executed NDA before sharing.

tara_compliance: Uploaded presigned link (expires 7 days): https://internal-s3.redwood.net/presign/EVID-4590/newbank-poc-bundle.zip?exp=7d (internal only).

maria_sales: Sending link to NewBank procurement now and asking if legal signature required prior to download. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
